_about.en: What the scraper collects: per-brand price ranges, the selected brands and the listing search query. Read by scraper/collection.py (the scraper) and analysis/01_dedup_leakage.py (technical report §1 prints these filters and counts their footprint in the data). brands.DEFAULT is used for a selected brand without its own range; not_selected lists brands that were scraped once and are switched off.
_about.tr: Scraper'ın ne topladığı: marka başına fiyat aralıkları, seçili markalar ve ilan arama sorgusu. scraper/collection.py (scraper) ve analysis/01_dedup_leakage.py okur (teknik rapor §1 bu filtreleri basar ve verideki karşılıklarını sayar). brands.DEFAULT kendi aralığı olmayan seçili marka için kullanılır; not_selected bir kez taranıp kapatılan markalar.
